To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the flexural properties of sisal fiber reinforced resin composites can be improved through chemical treatment of the sisal fiber.
the flexural strength and modulus of the composites decreased with increasing fiber content and increased with chemical treatments.
the fiber content, fiber treatment, matrix and fiber/matrix adhesions play an important role in flexural properties of composites.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of fiber content and fiber treatment on the mechanical properties of sisal fiber reinforced composites.
the development of sisal fiber reinforced composites with enhanced flexural properties.
the flexural strength and modulus properties of sisal fiber reinforced composites.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the flexural properties of the composites could be tailored by varying the fiber content and chemical treatment.
the fiber/matrix interface is the key factor that determines the mechanical properties of the composites.
the fiber treatment improved both flexural strength and modulus of the sisal fiber reinforced composites.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the flexural properties of the composites can be improved by chemical treatment of the sisal fibers.
the flexural strength and modulus of the composites can be enhanced by using a suitable chemical treatment of the sisal fibers.

chemical treatment of sisal fiber is an effective method to improve the mechanical properties of the composites, however, the effect of chemical treatment on flexural strength of the sisal fiber composites was found less effective compared to flexural modulus of the sisal composites.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the flexural properties of composites could be enhanced by chemical treatment of the fibers and the use of a higher volume fraction of fibers.
fiber treatment is an important step for improving the flexural properties of natural fiber composites.
the flexural strength of the sisal fiber reinforced composites could be improved by using alkali and silane treatment.
